title: Type Of Material Superconductor
definition: Superconductors are materials that exhibit zero electrical resistance and the expulsion of magnetic flux fields (Meissner effect) when cooled below a characteristic critical temperature (Tc).
importanceInUpsc: Essential for Science & Tech (Physics) syllabus; frequently linked to emerging tech like Quantum Computing, Maglev trains, and MRI technology.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Type Of Material Superconductor.
